title: ‘Obsession’: Here’s Where to Stream the Horror Romance Movie Online
summary: One of the summer's biggest horror hits is now available to watch online at home.
contentText:

After earning more than $429 million at the worldwide box office, Obsession has become one of the biggest sleeper hit movies of the year. Along with A24’s Backrooms and the sci-fi horror film Iron Lung , the horror romance is part of a growing trend of content creators making the leap from YouTube to the big screen.

How to Watch ‘Obsession’ Online

The streaming platform doesn’t offer a free trial, but Peacock does come with a couple of affordable plans starting at $10.99 per month. In addition, you can get 30 days of access to Peacock for as low as $1 with Walmart+ , as one of the service’s benefits and perks. Learn more about Walmart+ and Peacock here .

In the meantime, there are two different plans offered on Peacock: The Premium Plan for $10.99 per month or the Premium Plus Plan for $16.99 per month. If you’re looking to save, you can save 17% off when you do the annual plan for $109.99 per year or $169.99 per year. With the Premium Plan, it’s ad-supported and you’ll receive access to a wide range of movies, TV shows, originals, live sports from NBC Sports and live news from NBC News.

Peacock’s Premium Plus plan comes with everything in the Premium plan , no ads, your local NBC channel live and the ability to download and stream offline.

Alongside Obsession , you’ll have access to the entire Peacock library, including Reminders of Him , Yellowstone , Five Nights At Freddy’s and Five Nights At Freddy’s 2 , Vanderpump Rules , The Real Housewives of Beverly Hills , Poker Face , Saturday Night Live and others.

The streaming service also offers a number of music documentaries and specials, such as Toby Keith: An American Icon , Bowie: The Man Who Changed The World , Bob Dylan: The Folk Years , Stevie Nicks: Through The Looking Glass , Katy Perry: Main Square , Welcome To The A: 50 Years of Hip-Hop in Atlanta and more.

‘Obsession’; Synopsis & Cast

Written and directed by Curry Barker, Obsession follows Bear (Michael Johnston), a music shop employee who has a crush on his co-worker and friend Nikki (Inde Navarrette). After coming across a novelty toy called a “One Wish Willow,” Bear makes a wish that he instantly regrets — Nikki’s undying love.

The horror romance also stars Cooper Tomlinson, Megan Lawless, Andy Richter and others, while music was composed by Rock Burwell.

Obsession is available to stream on Peacock starting on Friday, July 17.
